text: The second (column) orthogonality relation implies $\sum_{\text{irr }V}|\chi_V(g)|^2=|G|$ for every $g\in G$.
explanation: False: column orthogonality gives $\sum_{\text{irr }V}|\chi_V(g)|^2=|G|/|C_g|$, where $|C_g|$ is the size of the conjugacy class of $g$. This equals $|G|$ only when $g$ lies in a singleton class (a central element such as $e$); for non-central $g$ the sum is strictly smaller.
